cases.purpose: Read live ptrace scope and independently controlled read-only private namespace views for valid, unknown, malformed and absent values.
cases.oracle: Same-process live procfs input, fixed expected descriptions and diagnostics, private read-only bind-mounted files, namespace UID/GID map and inode identity controls. No sysctl is written.
cases.comparison: Setup creates only private scratch data and tests good, malformed and absent views in fresh user/mount namespaces. Before mounting, the helper proves the sole UID/GID mapping is inner 0 to guest 2000, the mount namespace differs and no mounts are shared. It bind-mounts private data read-only, checks actual source/mount inode and read-only flags, then verifies bytes or absence. The candidate reads the live level and seven fresh controlled views; raw output and namespace identity records are saved. If user namespaces or bind/remount are unavailable setup is an infrastructure error, not candidate evidence.
cases.stdout: ptrace-scope live=yes levels=yes unknown=yes malformed=yes absent=yes
